name: HivePunk 547
subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: Uniswap v4-core appears documented as a mature, live protocol core with extensive review history, but the service check shows no recent repository activity, so evidence for ongoing shipping from this repository in the last 30 days is absent.

risks: The README describes the contracts as in early stages and released as draft code for public building and feedback.
Hook callbacks and pool actions rely on unlock deltas reaching 0 by the unlock's release, which is a complexity and integration risk.
Which callbacks are executed on a pool cannot change after pool initialization, limiting later changes to a pool's hook behaviour.
Recent inactivity shown by the check may indicate the core repository is not currently shipping new work, so users need an alternative source for updates.
The pages read do not state a latest release tag or date, so release freshness cannot be verified from them.
unknowns: Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
The Uniswap v4-core repository page shows 1,518 commits.: Its source holds no passage that says this.
The latest release tag and date for Uniswap v4-core.: The text of https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-core/releases was not among the pages read, and the pages read do not state a release tag or date.
wouldChangeMind: A releases page showing a recent tagged release would change the view on recent shipping.
Repository commit data showing recent real-work commits would contradict the current inactivity check.
Deployment or audit records tying deployed contracts to a specific recent release would change the freshness assessment.
